headline: Exports with obstacles: what hinders Kyrgyzstan's businesses from selling abroad
summary: More than half of surveyed Kyrgyz companies engaged in exports face regulatory and procedural obstacles when shipping products abroad. The findings were reported by 24.kg.
why: Export barriers raise costs and delays for producers selling abroad, which affects trade volumes and the competitiveness of exporting firms.
original_headline: Экспорт с препятствиями: что мешает бизнесу Кыргызстана продавать за рубеж
